text: Not to us, O LORD {YHWH}, not to us, but to Your name be the glory, because of Your loving devotion, because of Your faithfulness.
Why should the nations say, “Where is their God {Elohehem}?”
Our God {Elohenu} is in heaven; He does as He pleases.
Their idols are silver and gold, made by the hands of men.
They have mouths, but cannot speak; they have eyes, but cannot see;
they have ears, but cannot hear; they have noses, but cannot smell;
they have hands, but cannot feel; they have feet, but cannot walk; they cannot even clear their throats \they cannot utter with their throat/.
Those who make them become like them, as do all who trust in them.
O Israel [O house of Israel], trust in the LORD {YHWH}! He is their help and shield.
O house of Aaron (light bringer), trust in the LORD {YHWH}! He is their help and shield.
You who fear the LORD {YHWH}, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.
The LORD {YHWH} is mindful of us; He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel (he wrestles with God); He will bless the house of Aaron (light bringer);
He will bless those who fear the LORD {YHWH}—small and great alike.
May the LORD {YHWH} give you⁺ increase, both you⁺ and your⁺ children.
May you⁺ be blessed by the LORD {YHWH}, the Maker of heaven and earth.
The highest heavens belong to the LORD {YHWH}, but the earth He has given to mankind.
It is not the dead who praise the LORD, nor any who descend into silence.
But it is we who will bless the LORD, both now and forevermore. Hallelujah (Praise the LORD)!
